status: RL RESULT: run 9 iteration 1 vs BC, pooled over 225 paired condition-evaluations each: lift +0.044 (CI -0.13 to +0.19), return +0.58. NOT ESTABLISHED. Per-sweep lift of the same deterministic checkpoint ranged 0.36-0.96.
what_ran: Critic-free GRPO-style PPO with a KL anchor on the frozen BC head + zero-init residual (run9_grpo_preregistration.json). 2 iterations x 48 episodes; 102 gradient updates; 6029 s.
per_condition: BC failed lift on conditions [6, 11, 14, 15, 19]; run 9 lifts 4 of those 5 (all but 15). Lift 24/25 vs 20/25; mean max lift 0.130 m vs 0.123 m.

learning_signal.reading: One conservative update on a clean group signal produced the gain. The iteration-2 update did not improve the in-trainer evaluation (return 10.45 -> 4.29 on 8 post-rollout conditions) and its checkpoint has not been scored by the scorer of record yet.

why_this_worked_where_actor_critic_did_n: The learning signal is the simulator's return, standardised within groups of rollouts from the same initial condition. A perturbation that breaks the grasp is pushed down by what actually happened; no critic has to rank actions. Two independent critics (runs 7 and 8) rated exploration-scale perturbations of the BC action at chance (0.46, 0.49), so any actor that followed them drifted off-task.

continuation_run_9b.what: Same algorithm from run 9's best residual, groups 6x5, 4 iterations, SEED 1.
continuation_run_9b.in_trainer_best: iteration 4: return 13.81, grasp 1.00, lift 1.00 on 8 post-rollout conditions
continuation_run_9b.reading: The certified number (lift 0.64) is BELOW BC. The in-trainer selection was fooled: 8 conditions evaluated after stochastic rollouts are noisy and under- or over-score (g1_piston_in_trainer_eval_underscores.json). Run 9b's KL-to-base grew 0.014 -> 0.038 and approx-KL hit the 0.02 stop in three of four iterations: it moved further from the base than run 9 did. Whether the intermediate checkpoints were better is being measured (post-hoc scorer-of-record on every saved iteration).

next: Score every intermediate checkpoint of runs 9 and 9b with the scorer of record to learn the true training trajectory, then decide the continuation protocol (lower LR, select by a larger/fresh-process evaluation). Press remains 0.00 in every run: not in the data, not yet discovered.

first_press_stage_firing_in_the_project.where: run 9b, iteration 3 collection: press_rate 0.033 = 1 of 30 stochastic rollouts fired the v3 press stage (live-grasp gated, 28 mm), max plunger depth 31.2 mm that iteration. Iterations 2 and 4 also exceeded 28 mm (29.5, 29.8 mm) without the stage firing (not grasped at the time).
first_press_stage_firing_in_the_project.significance: The press is reachable by exploration from this policy, so the functional act is a discovery problem the critic-free objective can in principle solve: a pressing rollout carries the 12.0 stage bonus plus the dense 150/m term and receives a large positive group advantage. One event in ~200 rollouts is too rare to have moved the policy yet.
first_press_stage_firing_in_the_project.collection_rates_note: Collected (stochastic, sigma 0.15) grasp rates 0.50-0.75 and lift 0.13-0.63 are far below the deterministic policy's; exploration noise on 120 latent dimensions breaks many grasps, which is also what produces the within-group contrast the method learns from.

paired_repeats_scorer_of_record_n25_fres.reading: Mean lift 0.867 vs 0.707 (+0.16), plate 0.853 vs 0.693, return 12.91 vs 10.65 (+2.3); grasp 0.973 vs 0.960. The per-sweep spread (BC lift 0.60-0.80) shows the scorer's own noise, and the improvement holds in every pair. This is the strongest certification available without a larger suite.

DOWNGRADE_2026_09_13: On all 50 conditions BC scored lift 0.80 / return 12.14 vs run 9's 0.74 / 11.51, and on conditions 0-24 run 9 lifted 16/25 vs BC 21/25 -- reversing the 3/3 paired wins. Pooled over 125 paired condition-evaluations run 9 leads by only +0.07 lift, inside sweep-to-sweep noise (SD ~0.12 per sweep). The improvement is suggestive, not established. See g1_piston_eval_variance.json; more paired sweeps are queued.

FINAL_POOLED_VERDICT_2026_09_13.verdict: NOT ESTABLISHED. A small positive point estimate inside the evaluation noise.
